_comment: Structure comparison with coronagraphs (python -m ael coronagraph --config this.json --out new_dir/). Paths are relative to this file. Each image has its own solar frame: 'geometry' + 'p_angle_deg' (an ael geometry; celestial north and the solar P angle), 'wcs' (a helioprojective FITS header: K-Cor level 2, AIA level 1.5; 'rsun_arcsec' overrides RSUN_OBS), or the explicit 'center_xy' + 'north_px' + 'east_px' (pixel offsets of 1 Rsun towards solar north and east; may be affine). For LASCO level 0.5 build the frame with sunpy (see skills/coronagraph-comparison) and write it explicitly. 'bin' averages b x b blocks first (a block with any missing pixel is missing); 'normalise' false for an image that is already an NRGF. 'dark_sector' masks the contiguous dark run that contains the seed (an occulter pylon), never a global threshold. Agreement in position angle only: nothing here measures brightness.
